review_binding.meaning: Exact reviewed local inputs; not independent semantic, audio or live certification

required_for: every episode, every batch; no blanket pass substitutes for individual evidence
acceptance_scope: Captured-text development review only. Base extractions remain immutable drafts. No audio, external factual, publication or live-performance acceptance implied.

A1.reason: Complete captured-text review and coarse discussion map; qualified leaders with ties and timing limitations.

A2.reason: Full-source omission and identity reconciliation; unresolved references retained. Separate frozen source-first sample is a batch measure, not per-episode statistical recall.

A3.reason: Participants and contextual speaker assignments reviewed; no audio diarization certification.

A4.reason: Actions expanded and qualified; reported actor separated from reporter, possession from intent, playback media from game play.

A5.reason: Actual complete development answers source-adjudicated; required context retrieved through the database.

A6.reason: Written episode brief with corrections, callbacks, open loops and editorial suggestions desk-reviewed; live usefulness not certified.

A7.reason: Durable source-bound repairs merged, database rebuilt, exact-evidence and behavioral checks passed.

A8.reason: All eight recurring checks recorded with evidence; isolated uncertainties retained; no automatic production/audio acceptance.
